title: Add AI chat analysis with parliamentary language remedies and problems solved widget

requirements.text: Add a widget to the dashboard that displays the total number of problems solved, showing a count that can be updated when AI remedies are applied or problems are marked as resolved

quotes: it should havwe widget for  number probelem solved

acceptanceCriteria: Widget displays a numeric count of total problems solved
Count updates when problems are resolved through AI remedies or manual resolution
Widget is visible on the dashboard page

requirements.text: Implement AI-powered chat analysis that detects problems in conversations and automatically generates remedy suggestions to help resolve the identified issues

quotes: the aiit should give remedies to the probelems

acceptanceCriteria: AI analyzes chat messages to identify problems or conflicts
System generates specific remedy suggestions for detected problems
Remedies are displayed to users in the chat interface

requirements.text: Ensure all AI-generated remedy suggestions use only parliamentary language, maintaining formal, respectful, and dignified wording in all communications

quotes: the ai should only use parlimentary words

acceptanceCriteria: All AI remedy text uses formal parliamentary language conventions
Language is respectful, dignified, and avoids casual or colloquial expressions
Remedies maintain a professional tone appropriate for parliamentary discourse

requirements.text: Add a toggle control that allows users to enable or disable the AI remedy feature, preserving their preference across sessions

quotes: if user don't like the remedies they can turn it off

acceptanceCriteria: Toggle control is accessible in the chat interface or settings
When disabled, AI remedies are not generated or displayed
Toggle state is stored in user profile or local storage

constraints: AI remedy language must strictly adhere to parliamentary conventions
Existing AIConflictAnalysis component should be integrated or extended for chat analysis
Problems solved count must persist in backend storage
nonGoals: Integration with external AI services or APIs
